drawings.rocqProof:

intros_sigma ().
set (f_3 := f : Edge Vertex_2 Vertex_4).
destruct_sigma (@IdRight_rule Vertex_2 Vertex_3 Vertex_4 eq_refl f Edge_2 f_3 eq_refl isId_2) as Triangle_3.
exact (f, eq_refl, Triangle_3).
Qed.

drawings.name: PbkFromMono
drawings.rocqProof:
Lemma PbkFromMono_rule : forall (a a_2 a_3 d : Vertex)(eq_a_a_a : a = a_3)(eq_a_a_a_2 : a_3 = a_2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (e1 : Edge a a_2)(e2 : Edge a a_3)(f1 : Edge a_2 d)(f2 : Edge a_3 d)(eq_f1_f2 : f1 = f2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (isMono_2 : isMono f1)(isMono_3 : isMono f2)(isId_2 : isId e1)(isId_3 : isId e2), Pullback e1 e2 f2 f1)))).
intros_sigma ().
assert (Hpremise1 : Square e1 e2 f2 f1). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@IdLeftComp_rule a a_2 d eq_refl e1 f1 isId_2) as f _ Triangle_2.
  destruct_sigma (@IdLeft_rule a a_3 d eq_refl e2 f2 f eq_refl isId_3) as Triangle_3.
  destruct_sigma (@Square_rule a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 f Triangle_2 Triangle_3) as Square_3.
  exact Square_3.
}
assert (Hpremise2 : forall (x : Vertex)(Edge_2 : Edge x a_3)(Edge_3 : Edge x a_2)(Square_2 : Square Edge_3 Edge_2 f2 f1), Σ (Edge_4 : Edge x a)(Triangle_2 : Triangle Edge_4 e2 Edge_2), Triangle Edge_4 e1 Edge_3). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@Square___Def__reverse__rule x a_2 a_3 d Edge_3 f1 Edge_2 f2 Square_2) as Edge_5 Triangle_4 Triangle_5.
  destruct_sigma (@Mono2___Premise__reverse__rule a d x f1 Edge_2 Edge_3 Edge_5 Triangle_5 Triangle_4 isMono_2) as _.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule x a d Edge_2 f1 Edge_5 Edge_5 Triangle_4 Triangle_5) as _ _.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp2_rule x a a_3 eq_refl e2 Edge_2 isId_3) as f _ Triangle_6.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRight_rule x a a_2 eq_refl f e1 Edge_3 eq_refl isId_2) as Triangle_7.
  exact (Edge_2, Triangle_6, Triangle_7).
}
assert (Hpremise3 : forall (y : Vertex)(Edge_2 : Edge y a_3)(Edge_3 : Edge y a_2)(i j : Edge y a)(ju : Triangle j e2 Edge_2)(iu : Triangle i e2 Edge_2)(jf : Triangle j e1 Edge_3)(xif : Triangle i e1 Edge_3), i = j). {
  intros_sigma ().
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule y a a_2 eq_refl i e1 isId_2) as f _ Triangle_2.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule y a a i e1 Edge_3 i xif Triangle_2) as _ _.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule y a a_2 eq_refl j e1 isId_2) as f_2 _ Triangle_3.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule y a a j e1 Edge_3 j jf Triangle_3) as _ _.
  exact eq_refl.
}
destruct_sigma (@Pullback_rule a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f2 f1 Hpremise1 Hpremise2 Hpremise3) as Pullback_3.
exact Pullback_3.
Qed.
drawings.abellaProof:
Theorem PbkFromMono_rule : forall a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f1 f2 isMono_2 isMono_3 isId_2 isId_3, vertex a -> vertex a_2 -> vertex a_3 -> vertex d -> a = a_3 -> a_3 = a_2 -> edge a a_2 e1 -> edge a a_3 e2 -> edge a_2 d f1 -> edge a_3 d f2 -> f1 = f2 -> isMono f1 isMono_2 -> isMono f2 isMono_3 -> isId e1 isId_2 -> isId e2 isId_3 -> exists Pullback_2, pullback e1 e2 f2 f1 Pullback_2.
skip.

drawings.name: MonoFromPullback
drawings.rocqProof:
Lemma MonoFromPullback_rule : forall (a a_2 a_3 d : Vertex)(eq_a_a_a : a = a_3)(eq_a_a_a_2 : a_3 = a_2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (e1 : Edge a a_2)(e2 : Edge a a_3)(f1 : Edge a_2 d)(f2 : Edge a_3 d)(eq_f1_f2 : f1 = f2), ltac:(subst_all_in (forall (Pullback_2 : Pullback e1 e2 f2 f1)(isId_2 : isId e1)(isId_3 : isId e2), isMono f1)))).
intros_sigma ().
assert (Hpremise1 : forall (x : Vertex)(f g : Edge x a_2)(h : Edge x d)(fm : Triangle f f1 h)(gm : Triangle g f1 h), f = g). {
  intros_sigma ().
  set (g_2 := g : Edge x a_3).
  set (gm_2 := gm : Triangle g_2 f2 h).
  destruct_sigma (@Square_rule x a_3 a_2 d g_2 f f1 f2 h gm_2 fm) as Square_2.
  destruct_sigma (@Square_rule x a_2 a_3 d f g_2 f2 f1 h fm gm_2) as Square_3.
  destruct_sigma (@Pullback___Exist__reverse__rule a a_2 a_3 d x e1 e2 f2 f1 g_2 f Pullback_2 Square_3) as Edge_2 Triangle_2 Triangle_3.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule x a a_2 eq_refl Edge_2 e1 isId_2) as f_2 _ Triangle_4.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule x a a Edge_2 e1 f Edge_2 Triangle_3 Triangle_4) as _ _.
  destruct_sigma (@IdRightComp_rule x a a_3 eq_refl Edge_2 e2 isId_3) as f_3 _ Triangle_5.
  destruct_sigma (@UniqueCompo_rule x a a f e2 f g Triangle_5 Triangle_2) as _ _.
  exact eq_refl.
}
destruct_sigma (@Mono2_rule a_2 d f1 Hpremise1) as isMono_3.
exact isMono_3.
Qed.
drawings.abellaProof:
Theorem MonoFromPullback_rule : forall a a_2 a_3 d e1 e2 f1 f2 Pullback_2 isId_2 isId_3, vertex a -> vertex a_2 -> vertex a_3 -> vertex d -> a = a_3 -> a_3 = a_2 -> edge a a_2 e1 -> edge a a_3 e2 -> edge a_2 d f1 -> edge a_3 d f2 -> f1 = f2 -> pullback e1 e2 f2 f1 Pullback_2 -> isId e1 isId_2 -> isId e2 isId_3 -> exists isMono_2, isMono f1 isMono_2.
